thread:
nate: @maya-oncall getting a spike of GPU attach failures in syd1, looks like KMS timeouts when instances try to fetch DEK. errors: 504 from provider KMS endpoint. ops-bot sent an alert earlier. can we triage?

maya-oncall: I see the alert, paging infra. logs show repeated TLS handshakes failing, then timeouts. attaching new GPU nodes is retrying continuously.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 03:12 UTC syd1: kms-api.kpcloud.net latency > 3s (5xx rate 18%) - routed traffic count increasing.

ravi-infra: Confirmed peering plane is flapping between our VPC and provider in syd1. Control plane to kms endpoint occasionally drops packets causing long tails. Not all requests fail, but attach path hits the failure surface.

ana-runtime: (note: message from ana-runtime) tagging in - this is impacting Dedicated pool scaling and also some hosted API in syd1 that uses KMS for model key unwraps. For hosted customers we can fallback to cached DEKs for short windows, but dedicated node attach needs fresh unwrap.

leo-sre: Immediate mitigations: 1) stop autoscaling in syd1 (prevent churn), 2) enable KMS local cache where safe, 3) route non-PII inference to eu1/us-east1. I'll drop commands.

ravi-infra: Executing stop autoscale:
```
# disable GPU autoscale group for syd1
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-autoscaling gpu-syd1 --max-num-replicas 0
```

ravi-infra: Also applying egress route to proxy KMS through a stable peering in eu1 for control-plane calls: adding NAT/path via transit gateway. This will increase egress and add ~0.6ms median but avoids provider path.

maya-oncall: Good. Is there any customer-facing impact? Which customers will notice routing to eu1?

ana-runtime: Dedicated customers pinned to syd1 will see attach failures until nodes are already up. For hosted non-sensitive traffic we can failover read-only traffic to eu1 with zero state migration. We'll keep stateful workloads pinned and communicate.

leo-sre: I'm starting a canary shift: 5% of background batch inference -> eu1 and us-east1. If stable for 10m we'll increase. Can we set routing policy?

ravi-infra: Pushed routing rule (policy id: PR-19425) to route tag=batch-inference to eu1 with weight 5. config:
```
route set traffic --from syd1 --to eu1 --tag batch-inference --weight 5
```

nate: Thx. What about the KMS unwrap workaround for dedicated node attach? Any risk?

ana-runtime: Two options: 1) enable short-lived cached DEKs (30s) on attach path — lowers frequency of KMS calls; or 2) allow temporary unwrap via our regional HSM proxy in eu1 (requires egress). Option 1 is lower risk but might not cover first boot. Option 2 covers attach but increases egress and audit complexity.

maya-oncall: Let's enable short-lived DEK cache now and route attach unwraps via eu1 proxy as fallback. Ravi, please add egress ACL and ensure logging.

ravi-infra: Done: cache window set to 30s (config id: kms-cache-30s). Egress ACL updated to allow HSM proxy ip 3.12.45.67. Logging forwarded to splunk with tag=kmstunnel.

ops-bot: [INFO] 03:27 UTC policy PR-19425 applied; cache kms-cache-30s active.

leo-sre: Early metrics look promising: attach failures down from 23/min to 4/min in the last 4 minutes. Latency to kms endpoints still elevated but within retry budget.

nate: Good. Next steps: 1) keep autoscale paused, 2) run 30m canary increasing to 20% traffic if stable, 3) notify support + sales for customers in syd1 (possible L3 for pinned dedicated), 4) open an incident with provider support and request peering engineer escalation.

maya-oncall: I'll own customer comms. Ravi, please raise the provider ticket and add me + nate.

ravi-infra: Provider ticket created INC-8923. Escalated to Peering NOC. ETA 90m. I've attached packet captures and TLS logs.

ana-runtime: Also lowering non-critical model rollout frequency in syd1 to avoid churn (pause canary rollouts).

leo-sre: Cost note: routing control-plane unwraps via eu1 will incur cross-region egress; estimate additional $2.5k/day if this persists at current rate. Flagging finance and account execs.

nate: ack. If provider doesn't fix within 2 hours we will start evacuating lower-priority Dedicated shards to au-sg (capacity permitting) and start a formal incident bridge.

maya-oncall: Got it. Standby for updates. :wave:
